# Results for the paper (generated; do not edit)

Generated by `scripts/paper/build_paper_numbers.py`. Every block is copied verbatim from the named final-numbers document, which is itself generated from committed result files. Blend numbers (sections 1 to 4) are the frozen v5 BASE; pure-compound numbers (sections 5 to 7) are dev CV on tuning rows and are optimistic. No laboratory validation exists; certification is model-level only. Where a model does not beat a constant the status is: no skill shown.

## 1. Blend properties: headline results (v5, frozen BASE)

Source: `docs/final_numbers_v5.md`, heading "A. Headline results per property"

Selection rule (mechanical, in the script): designated scoreboard rows of the headline properties with no temperature split, for T2 real fuels (pooled sets), CRC 647 r3 (dev and fold_b), T1 lab (dev) and T3 AJFTD bulk models (dev); rows with status `no_evaluation` and the trivial comparator models are excluded (the trivial MAE is a column). Error = predicted - measured; viscosity in ln(pred/meas). `mae_trivial` is the scoreboard's trivial comparator (leave-one-group-out constant). Tier: T1 = lab pure/mixture data, T2 = real fuels with measured composition, T3 = AJFTD bulk-property regressions, CRC647_r3 = real fuels with reconstructed composition.

**Freezing on real fuels, in plain words.** Neither freezing route beats the trivial constant on real fuels. The designated route (UNIFAC SvL, CLM-73) reads `no_skill_shown` on the pooled T2 set (n 50, MAE 8.425 C vs constant 6.413 C) and `worse_than_trivial` on the locked set (n 8, MAE 9.31 C vs 5.176 C). UNIFAC SvL is validated only on the 12-system lab liquidus set S_F. The real-fuel coverage of its 13.84 C margin (0.98 pooled / 0.875 locked) is uninformative, because the bias is +4.3 to +5.9 C (over-prediction), so a one-sided margin covers it almost automatically. The UNIFAC rows are read from `results/v5/BASE/delta_freeze_t2_unifac/summary.csv` (not scoreboard cells); the `ideal_svl` rows are the scoreboard cells. The pooled UNIFAC n is 50 vs the scoreboard's 49, because AJFTD:325 is scored with the designated constants (see section F).

**Two route notes (read before quoting).**

* **Freezing.** The adopted designated freezing route is UNIFAC Schroeder-van Laar (CLM-73), but every BASE freezing cell aggregates committed CSVs, so the scoreboard freezing rows above are still the ideal SvL (`ideal_svl`) route. UNIFAC SvL is scored on real fuels (T2) only in `delta_freeze_t2_unifac` (the `svl_unifac` rows of Table A, no skill shown); its gated evidence is the lab liquidus set S_F:

| set | model | variant | n_systems | n_rows | mae | bias | mae_constant | margin_alpha10 | frac_unsafe |

| lab_liquidus_S_F | svl_unifac | designated (CLM-73) | 12 | 73 | 3.935 | 2.466 | 15.63 | 13.84 | 0.2603 |
| lab_liquidus_S_F | svl_verified | variant (ideal SvL) | 12 | 73 | 4.474 | 1.17 | 15.63 | 16.98 | 0.3288 |

* **Viscosity.** The scoreboard's designated T2 viscosity route is `refutas_raw` (v4 routing), and its cold bins are `worse_than_trivial`. `ml_pair_residual`, the designated in-domain viscosity of `predict_fuel`, has gate evidence on lab mixtures only (section D); its real-fuel transfer is descriptive and mixed.

* **D86.** All distillation cells are `no_evaluation` (exploratory) in the scoreboard; no D86 accuracy is claimed here.

Source: `docs/final_numbers_v5.md`, heading "D. Machine learning"

`margin_physics_baseline` is computed on the same systems as `margin_ml` (Refutas on the ML delta's dev systems; ideal volume on the density delta's locked systems). `applied_physics_margin_yaml` is the margin the yaml applies to the physics route, derived on its own system set; each carries its own n.

Reading: R-MLV-3 passed; the gate is the per-system macro row (bootstrap CI). The row-level figure is shown too. R-MLD-3 mixes bases: its gain is row-level while its CI is the per-system macro CI (`ci_basis`). At >= 283 K the ML margin is tighter (0.134 vs 0.185 ln) but covers 64 of 70 locked systems against 66 of 70 for Refutas. R-MLV-5 (real fuels, descriptive) is mixed: a large gain at 233/253 K, worse at several warm cells; no claim beyond lab mixtures is made. ## 4. Inverse design (v5; model-level certification only)

Source: `docs/final_numbers_v5.md`, heading "E. Inverse-design results"

Judge-certified under the model: **3 of 16** (P0y astm:jet_a, P0y-b astm:jet_a, P0y-b bis:jet_a1). None is lab-certified. All 3 carry `d86_model_dependent`, `freezing_route_dependent` and `overlay_dependent`, so none is certified under every reported route. The freezing bound uses UNIFAC SvL + 13.84 C; the ideal SvL bound (+16.98 C) exceeds the limit for all 3 of them. P0y-b Jet A-1 contains 37.8 wt % dicycloparaffin, above the AJFTD GCxGC maximum of 30 %. The declared expectation that P0y-b Jet A-1 fails freezing is refuted for the designated route (true only on the ideal SvL variant). P1-P3 are not certified: P1 jet_a1 fails 4 constraints (flash_point_C, freezing_point_C, distillation_T50_minus_T10_C, distillation_T90_minus_T10_C); the other 5 P1-P3 rows fail none but leave 11 constraints uncertified (no declared margins).

## 1. o-/m-xylene eutectic correction (applied)

Entered 66.6 percent o / 33.4 percent m; ideal Schroeder-van Laar at 211.2 K from the paper's Tm and dHfus gives about 32 percent o / 66 percent m, so the percentages were transposed and are corrected in `ingest_calorimetry_primary.py` (checked by consistency, not against the page image). Lab liquidus S_F, 12 systems, 73 points:

| route | MAE before | MAE after | margin before | margin after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ideal | 4.4741 | 4.1873 | unchanged | unchanged (16.975 ideal, 13.843 UNIFAC) |
| unifac | 3.9346 | 3.6479 | unchanged | unchanged (16.975 ideal, 13.843 UNIFAC) |

Margins are the worst-error order statistics over 12 systems and did not move. The frozen scoreboard is unchanged (reproduce_base: 0 changed files). Designs were not re-run.

## 6. Fresh flash lock constants (not done)

34 of the 40 lock compounds lack both Antoine constants and LFL (list: `results/v11/lock_missing_constants.csv`, mostly alcohols, esters, ketones and phenol). Verified constants for them are a data task like v9 and v10 and were not attempted; estimated constants would break the lock rule that nothing is fitted before scoring. Status: not scorable.

Overall: one correction applied (item 1, margins unchanged); no tuned or ensembled model adopted in this round.

## 15. v7 fresh flash lock

Source: `results/v7/lock/scored/NOT_SCORABLE.md`

`scripts/v7/flash/score_fresh_lock.py` was run once (user authorised spending the lock, 2026-11-23). The v5 flash route (`flash_unifac._prepare`) reports missing Antoine or LFL constants for every one of the 658 rows (61 systems), so no ideal, UNIFAC or HANNA flash point was produced and no prediction was compared with a measurement. Additionally HANNA is binary-only, and 215 of the 658 rows are ternary or quaternary.

Outcome: primary comparison (HANNA vs UNIFAC) not evaluated, status: no skill shown. The gate was neither passed nor failed. Scoring would need Antoine and LFL constants for the lock compounds; that is outside v7 scope and is not done. `predictions.csv` and `summary.json` here are empty or NaN by construction.
